Open a photo in your gallery, Telegram or browser, tap “Share” and pick KARTUN — the photo opens here, ready to enhance.
The result would exceed %1$s MP — for this photo choose up to %2$d×
Limit — %1$s MP. %2$d× does not fit for this photo; %3$s× does (%4$s)
Scale is how many times the photo\'s width and height grow: 1×, 2×, 4×, 8× or 16×; 4× by default.

• 4× — the native scale of the models: they are trained to enlarge exactly 4 times and give the best result at 4×.\n• 1× and 2× — the same 4× pass, then the result is reduced to the chosen size; 1× only removes noise and blur.\n• 8× and 16× — two passes: 4–16 times longer, a very large file.
A model is a trained neural network. Models differ in what pictures they learned from: one restores photos better, another drawings.

• Every model in the catalogue is trained to enlarge 4 times: at 4× it gives the best result.\n• This screen shows the two models you used last.\n• «All models» lists every model: what it is for, its author, licence and size. Download the ones you need; they work without the network.

As the system or KARTUN\'s own
The network runs on the phone\'s graphics chip through Vulkan — about 15 times faster than on the processor.
• On — the normal mode.\n• Off — the processor only: slow, but it helps if this phone\'s graphics chip fails.
The system list of KARTUN\'s languages opens: the app\'s language can differ from the phone\'s.
How to use KARTUN and its models
Tap to compare before and after
KARTUN is busy with a job over the API. Your photo is next.
Allowed: progress and “Your photo is ready”
While the network works, the shade shows the percent and “Cancel”, and a notification tells you when the photo is ready. Without the permission the processing still runs, only without the shade.
The notification permission was refused earlier, and KARTUN can no longer ask for it by itself. Turn notifications on by hand in Android\'s settings for KARTUN.

A compact Real-ESRGAN model for any image. It is fast and removes noise and blur only lightly.
• On photos it gives a softer result than Real-ESRGAN x4plus.

The main Real-ESRGAN model for real-world photos. It was trained on photos with artificial defects: blur, noise, downscaling and JPEG compression. An old phone photo collects such defects after editing and posting to social media.
• Gives a clean result with minimal distortion.\n• Fine texture can be smoothed out, and the photo starts to look like a drawing.
The Real-ESRGAN model for anime and illustrations, more compact than Real-ESRGAN x4plus.
• Keeps flat colour areas even and lines clean.\n• Can lose fine detail.
The most compact Real-ESRGAN model, made for anime video frames. It renders the original colours faithfully and gives little distortion.
• Suits drawn images, cartoons, comics and manga.\n• Does not suit photos and videos of real people.
A model for photos with JPEG compression and slight blur. It was trained on the Nomos8k photo set and gives a realistic result.
An anime model. It was trained on frames from modern anime films with light JPEG compression and blur added.
A model for photos with noise and compression traces. It cleans the photo of noise and compression traces.
A universal model for clean and slightly compressed images (JPEG quality 75 out of 100 and above).
• Handles realistic photos well: people, skin, fur, fine detail.\n• Adds grain and can give excessive sharpness.\n• White dots may appear on dark and flat areas.
A model for photos from the web. It was trained on shots with noise, lens blur and repeated JPEG and WebP compression.
• Not meant for images that were already enlarged.
A model for realistic shots: faces, hair, nature. It gives a soft, natural result with minimal distortion. It is meant for fairly clean shots without heavy grain.
• Fast; the model file is under 1 MB.\n• Shots with a blurred background (bokeh) may get distortion.
A blend of several photo models, among them 4x NMKD Siax and 4x NMKD Superscale. It keeps detail and smooths little: skin does not blur.
• Keeps skin, hair and texture well; suits comic pages and cartoon frames.\n• Can give excessive sharpness and distortion.
A model of the UltraMix family: a blend of the first UltraSharp and other models by the same maker. UltraMix models give a more balanced result than UltraSharp.
• Keeps sharpness and detail; suits blurry scans before printing.
The light version of UltraSharp V2 for photos, anime, drawings, computer graphics and text.
• Much faster than the full UltraSharp V2.
The full version of UltraSharp V2 for photos, anime, cartoons, drawings, computer graphics and text. It removes noise and traces of JPEG compression.
• Draws detail, materials and buildings well; renders drawings and illustrations faithfully.\n• Very slow.
